tools.name: submitExpense
tools.description: Submit a business expense (merchant, amount, currency, category, date) and return a confirmation with the created expense id.

merchant.description: Merchant or vendor name, for example 'Lufthansa' or 'Hotel Adlon'.

amount.description: Expense amount as a positive number, without a currency symbol.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example EUR or USD. Defaults to EUR.

date.description: Date the expense was incurred, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: listExpenses
tools.description: Return the most recently submitted expenses.

limit.description: Maximum number of expense rows to return.
